sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 8536 of 2023
Applicant :- Upendra Kumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Anita Singh,Kumari Poonam Rajpoot,Nirmla Kumari,Prem Babu Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.

2. Heard Ms. Anita Singh, learned counsel for applicant as well as Sri Anit Kumar Shukla, learned Additional Government Advocate for State.
3. The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Complaint No.1306 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Hathras Junction, District Hathras.

sentences.text: After arguing for some time, applicant's counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be disposed of with a direction to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the applicant.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, no case is made out for interference U/s 438 Cr.P.C.

The present anticipatory bail application is disposed of with a direction that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned court within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7.

For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicant before the concerned court, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant, in the above case.

(Krishan Pahal, J.) Order Date :- 10.8.2023 Ravi Kant  Upendra Kumar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74926745/
